forecast.reasoning: The 0.9% YES price at $9.9M volume represents near-market-certainty that Haley does NOT win the 2028 nomination. Key factors: (1) JD Vance is the constitutional successor and presumptive 2028 frontrunner as sitting VP; (2) Haley lost the 2024 primary decisively to Trump and has been absent from Trump's second-term administration — no cabinet position, no platform to build 2028 momentum; (3) The post-2024 MAGA realignment of the GOP makes a traditional conservative like Haley structurally disadvantaged — the party base has moved toward economic populism and America-first foreign policy, not Chamber-of-Commerce Republicanism; (4) Haley would be 56 in 2028 — not too old, but without an electoral base since leaving the SC governorship in 2017; (5) The $9.9M volume with only 0.9% YES means smart money is heavily short — this is not a market where contrarian value exists. Confidence 0.995 reflects near-certainty. The 0.5% residual captures: Vance scandal/health event, Trump family endorsement of Haley, catastrophic GOP realignment.
